_comment: Mastered service metadata. Keys are STAGE-1 service aliases produced by openapi-generation/azure_sdk_to_openapi.py (SDK package derived; they match provider-dev/source/ files and stage-1 name-overrides keys). Fields: provider (azure_extras/azure_isv/azure_stack; absent = base azure), title + description (Azure product name; stamped into the emitted info block and providerServices - SHOW SERVICES and web docs), name (cosmetic rename - the FINAL service name used for the emitted file, resource ids and providerServices), mergeInto (fold this service into the named final service; only possible when all members share identical servers - mgmt-plane and data-plane hosts can never merge), dropResources (merge members: superseded duplicate resources to drop), resourceRenames (merge members: resolve cross-member resource name collisions). A mergeInto target with no source file of its own gets a virtual entry keyed by the final name (e.g. ai_language) carrying title/description. Split rules: azure = core; azure_extras = domain-specific (health, agri, M365/desktop, operator/telco), retired/retiring, niche; azure_isv = Azure Native ISV / [Partner]-labeled; azure_stack = Azure Stack / Azure Local family.
